answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 4954 Country: India Title: Is working in banks, insurance, or financing companies and also tell me working in auditor office is jayaz(halal). Also Suggests me any other job related to similar fields which are haram and not permmisible in Islam. Question: Assalamualikum, Is working in banks, insurance, or financing companies and also tell me working in auditor office is jayaz(halal). Also Suggests me any other job related to similar fields which are haram and not permmisible in Islam. Answer ID: 4954 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1013/845=B/1429) Working in fianancing company is unlawful. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) cursed those who eat interest, feed interest, write account of interest and bear witness to it. But, working in auditor office (where one checks the accounts and certifies it) is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
